metadata.title: Android Privacy API Knowledge Base
metadata.description: Knowledge base of Android APIs relevant to privacy compliance and security

apis.name: LocationManager
apis.description: Provides access to the system location services, allowing applications to obtain periodic updates of the device's geographical location.

privacy_impact.description: This API accesses the device's physical location data.

methods.name: requestLocationUpdates
methods.signature: void requestLocationUpdates(String provider, long minTime, float minDistance, LocationListener listener)
methods.description: Register for location updates using a named provider and listener.

parameters.provider: Name of the provider with which to register
parameters.minTime: Minimum time interval between location updates in milliseconds
parameters.minDistance: Minimum distance between location updates in meters
parameters.listener: LocationListener to register for location updates

privacy_impact.description: Continuously tracks device location and sends updates to the application.

methods.name: getLastKnownLocation
methods.description: Returns the last known location for a provider.

privacy_impact.description: Retrieves the device's last known physical location.

apis.name: FusedLocationProviderClient
apis.description: Main entry point for interacting with the fused location provider, a location API that combines signals from GPS, Wi-Fi, cell networks, and device sensors.

privacy_impact.description: This API accesses the device's physical location using multiple data sources.

methods.name: getLastLocation
methods.description: Gets the best most recent location currently available.

privacy_impact.description: Retrieves the device's most recent physical location.

methods.name: requestLocationUpdates
methods.signature: Task<Void> requestLocationUpdates(LocationRequest request, LocationCallback callback, Looper looper)
methods.description: Requests location updates with a callback on the specified Looper thread.

privacy_impact.description: Continuously tracks device location and sends updates to the application.

apis.name: GeofencingClient
apis.description: Main entry point for interacting with the geofencing APIs.

privacy_impact.description: Monitors device location to detect when it enters or exits specified geographical areas.

methods.name: addGeofences
methods.description: Adds geofences to be monitored by the system.

parameters.request: The request object containing the geofences to add
parameters.pendingIntent: The pending intent to launch when a geofence transition occurs

privacy_impact.description: Monitors location in the background to detect when a device enters or exits defined geographic areas.

apis.name: Camera
apis.description: Legacy API for camera access. Controls the camera and captures pictures and videos.

privacy_impact.description: This API accesses the device's camera hardware, capable of capturing photos and videos.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Creates a new Camera object to access the first back-facing camera on the device.

privacy_impact.description: Opens and initializes the camera hardware for capturing images or video.

methods.name: takePicture
methods.signature: void takePicture(ShutterCallback shutter, PictureCallback raw, PictureCallback jpeg)
methods.description: Triggers an asynchronous image capture.

privacy_impact.description: Captures images using the device camera, potentially including people, sensitive documents, or surroundings.

apis.name: CameraManager
apis.description: Modern API for discovering and opening camera devices.

privacy_impact.description: This API provides access to camera hardware which can capture photos and videos of users and their surroundings.

methods.name: openCamera
methods.signature: void openCamera(String cameraId, CameraDevice.StateCallback callback, Handler handler)
methods.description: Opens a connection to a camera with the given ID.

parameters.cameraId: The unique identifier for the camera device

privacy_impact.description: Opens and initializes the camera hardware for capturing images or video of users and their surroundings.

methods.name: getCameraIdList
methods.description: Returns the list of currently connected camera devices by ID.

privacy_impact.description: Returns information about available cameras but doesn't access the cameras themselves.

apis.name: CameraSelector
apis.description: Used to select a camera for use cases in the CameraX Jetpack library.

privacy_impact.description: Facilitates camera selection and initialization, enabling access to camera hardware.

methods.name: bindToLifecycle
methods.description: Binds use cases to a lifecycle owner with this selector.

parameters.lifecycleOwner: The lifecycle owner for the use cases

privacy_impact.description: Enables camera access and processing for capturing images, video, or analyzing camera preview data.

constants.name: DEFAULT_FRONT_CAMERA
constants.description: Default camera selector for the front camera.

constants.name: DEFAULT_BACK_CAMERA
constants.description: Default camera selector for the back camera.

apis.name: MediaRecorder
apis.description: Records audio and video. Used for capturing audio from microphone.

privacy_impact.description: This API accesses the device's microphone to record audio, potentially capturing private conversations.

methods.name: setAudioSource
methods.description: Sets the audio source to be used for recording.

privacy_impact.description: Configures the microphone or other audio source for recording audio.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins capturing and encoding data to the file specified with setOutputFile().

privacy_impact.description: Activates the microphone and begins recording audio, potentially capturing private conversations.

constants.name: AudioSource.MIC
constants.description: Microphone audio source.

constants.name: AudioSource.VOICE_COMMUNICATION
constants.description: Voice communication (e.g., VoIP) audio source.

apis.name: AudioRecord
apis.description: Manages audio resources for applications that record audio data from the audio input hardware.

privacy_impact.description: This API provides low-level access to capture audio data from the microphone.

methods.name: startRecording
methods.description: Starts recording from the audio hardware.

privacy_impact.description: Activates the microphone and begins capturing raw audio data.

methods.name: read
methods.signature: int read(byte[] audioData, int offsetInBytes, int sizeInBytes)
methods.description: Reads audio data from the audio hardware for recording.

parameters.audioData: The array to which the recorded audio data is written
parameters.offsetInBytes: The offset in audioData where data is written

privacy_impact.description: Reads raw audio data from the microphone, potentially capturing private conversations.

apis.name: ContactsContract
apis.description: The contract between the contacts provider and applications. Contains definitions for the supported URIs and columns.

privacy_impact.description: This API allows access to the user's contact information, including names, phone numbers, email addresses, and other personal data.

constants.name: AUTHORITY
constants.description: The authority for the contacts provider.

apis.name: ContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Phone
apis.description: Contains definitions for accessing phone number data in ContactsContract.Data table.

privacy_impact.description: This API provides access to contact phone numbers stored on the device.

constants.name: CONTENT_URI
constants.description: The content URI for phone number data.

constants.name: NUMBER
constants.description: The phone number as the user entered it.

apis.name: ContactsContract.CommonDataKinds.Email
apis.description: Contains definitions for accessing email address data in ContactsContract.Data table.

privacy_impact.description: This API provides access to contact email addresses stored on the device.

constants.name: CONTENT_URI
constants.description: The content URI for email data.

constants.name: ADDRESS
constants.description: The email address.

apis.name: CalendarContract
apis.description: The contract between the calendar provider and applications. Contains definitions for the supported URIs and columns.

privacy_impact.description: This API allows access to the user's calendar data, including events, attendees, and reminders.

constants.name: AUTHORITY
constants.description: The authority for the calendar provider.

apis.name: CalendarContract.Events
apis.description: Contains definitions for accessing calendar events.

privacy_impact.description: This API provides access to calendar events, including titles, locations, and attendees.

constants.name: CONTENT_URI
constants.description: The content URI for events.

constants.name: TITLE
constants.description: The title of the event.

constants.name: EVENT_LOCATION
constants.description: The location of the event.

apis.name: TelephonyManager
apis.description: Provides access to information about the telephony services on the device.

privacy_impact.description: This API accesses sensitive phone information including identifiers and phone numbers.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the unique device ID, for example, the IMEI for GSM and the MEID or ESN for CDMA phones.

privacy_impact.description: Accesses the device's IMEI or other hardware identifier, which is a persistent, unique device identifier.

methods.name: getImei
methods.description: Returns the IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity).

privacy_impact.description: Accesses the device's IMEI, which is a persistent, unique device identifier.

methods.name: getLine1Number
methods.description: Returns the phone number string for line 1, for example, the MSISDN for a GSM phone.

privacy_impact.description: Accesses the user's phone number, a sensitive piece of personal information.

apis.name: CallLog
apis.description: The contract between the call log provider and applications. Contains definitions for the supported URIs and columns.

privacy_impact.description: This API accesses the user's call history, including numbers, dates, durations, and types of calls.

apis.name: CallLog.Calls
apis.description: Contains the call log table, which describes all phone calls stored on the device.

privacy_impact.description: This API provides direct access to call log entries including phone numbers called, call durations, and timestamps.

constants.name: CONTENT_URI
constants.description: The content URI for the call log table.

constants.name: NUMBER
constants.description: The phone number as the user entered it.

constants.name: DATE
constants.description: The date the call occurred, in milliseconds since the epoch.

constants.name: DURATION
constants.description: The duration of the call in seconds.

apis.name: Telephony
apis.description: The contract between the telephony provider and applications. Contains definitions for accessing SMS and MMS data.

privacy_impact.description: This API accesses the user's text messages, which can contain sensitive personal information.

apis.name: Telephony.Sms
apis.description: Contains definitions for accessing SMS messages.

privacy_impact.description: This API provides direct access to SMS messages, including sender, content, and timestamp.

constants.name: CONTENT_URI
constants.description: The content URI for SMS messages.

constants.name: INBOX_CONTENT_URI
constants.description: The content URI for inbox SMS messages.

apis.name: Environment
apis.description: Provides access to environment variables, including storage directories.

privacy_impact.description: This API provides access to external storage directories where user files may be stored.

methods.name: getExternalStorageDirectory
methods.description: Returns the primary external storage directory.

privacy_impact.description: Provides access to the external storage directory where user files may be stored.

methods.name: getExternalStoragePublicDirectory
methods.description: Returns the directory for storing files of a particular type on the external storage.

parameters.type: The type of files directory to return

privacy_impact.description: Provides access to public directories on external storage where user media files are typically stored.

constants.name: DIRECTORY_PICTURES
constants.description: Standard directory where pictures are stored.

constants.name: DIRECTORY_DOCUMENTS
constants.description: Standard directory where documents are stored.

apis.name: MediaStore
apis.description: The contract between the media provider and applications. Contains definitions for accessing media files.

privacy_impact.description: This API provides access to media files stored on the device, including photos, videos, and audio.

constants.name: Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI
constants.description: The content URI for external images media.

constants.name: Video.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI
constants.description: The content URI for external video media.

constants.name: Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI
constants.description: The content URI for external audio media.

apis.name: Settings.Secure
apis.description: Contains secure system settings, such as the android id.

privacy_impact.description: This API provides access to secure system settings, including the Android ID which is a persistent device identifier.

methods.name: getString
methods.signature: static String getString(ContentResolver resolver, String name)
methods.description: Retrieve a secure system setting value by name.

privacy_impact.description: Retrieves secure settings, which may include sensitive information if certain settings are queried.

constants.name: ANDROID_ID
constants.description: A 64-bit number (as a hex string) that is uniquely assigned to each device.

apis.name: WifiManager
apis.description: Provides the primary API for managing all aspects of Wi-Fi connectivity.

privacy_impact.description: This API can access network information and previously provided MAC address of the WiFi device.

methods.name: getConnectionInfo
methods.description: Returns dynamic information about the current Wi-Fi connection, if any is active.

privacy_impact.description: Provides information about the current WiFi connection, including network name and signal strength.

methods.name: getMacAddress
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the Wi-Fi interface.

privacy_impact.description: Retrieves the MAC address, which is a persistent hardware identifier that could be used for tracking.

apis.name: BiometricPrompt
apis.description: A unified API for biometric authentication on Android.

privacy_impact.description: This API interacts with biometric sensors for user authentication. While it doesn't directly expose biometric data to apps, it handles sensitive biometric operations.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.signature: void authenticate(CancellationSignal cancel, Executor executor, AuthenticationCallback callback)
methods.description: Requests authentication with a biometric sensor.

privacy_impact.description: Initiates biometric authentication, interfacing with biometric hardware but not exposing raw biometric data to the app.

apis.name: ConnectivityManager
apis.description: Class that answers queries about the state of network connectivity.

privacy_impact.description: This API provides information about the device's network connectivity state and capabilities.

methods.name: getActiveNetworkInfo
methods.description: Gets information about the currently active default data network.

privacy_impact.description: Provides details about the active network connection, which may reveal information about the user's connectivity.

methods.name: getNetworkCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the NetworkCapabilities of the given network.

parameters.network: The Network to get capabilities for

privacy_impact.description: Provides detailed information about network capabilities, including connection type and properties.

apis.name: PackageManager
apis.description: Class for retrieving various package information.

privacy_impact.description: This API can retrieve information about installed applications, which may reveal user interests and behavior patterns.

methods.name: getInstalledPackages
methods.description: Returns a List of all packages that are installed on the device.

privacy_impact.description: Retrieves a list of all installed applications, which may reveal user interests and behavior patterns.

methods.name: getInstalledApplications
methods.description: Returns a List of all installed applications on the device.

privacy_impact.description: Retrieves information about all installed applications, which may reveal user interests and behavior patterns.

apis.name: UsageStatsManager
apis.description: Provides access to device usage history and statistics.

privacy_impact.description: This API provides detailed information about how the user interacts with apps, including usage duration and frequency.

methods.name: queryUsageStats
methods.signature: List<UsageStats> queryUsageStats(int intervalType, long beginTime, long endTime)
methods.description: Gets usage statistics for the given time range.

parameters.intervalType: The time interval by which the stats are aggregated
parameters.beginTime: The inclusive beginning of the range of stats to include in the results
parameters.endTime: The exclusive end of the range of stats to include in the results

privacy_impact.description: Retrieves detailed statistics about app usage, including which apps were used when and for how long, revealing user behavior patterns.

apis.name: ClipboardManager
apis.description: Manages data on the system clipboard.

privacy_impact.description: This API can read and write data on the system clipboard, which may contain sensitive information copied by the user.

methods.name: getPrimaryClip
methods.description: Returns the current primary clip on the clipboard.

privacy_impact.description: Reads the contents of the clipboard, which may contain passwords, personal data, or other sensitive information copied by the user.

methods.name: setPrimaryClip
methods.description: Sets the current primary clip on the clipboard.

privacy_impact.description: Writes data to the clipboard, potentially replacing existing content that may be needed by the user.

apis.name: ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
apis.description: Allows an app to access precise location. This is a dangerous permission that grants access to the user's exact location.

apis.name: ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
apis.description: Allows an app to access approximate location. This provides less precise location than ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION but still reveals the user's general area.

apis.name: ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION
apis.description: Allows an app to access location in the background. This is a dangerous permission that enables location tracking even when the app isn't actively being used.

apis.name: CAMERA
apis.description: Required to be able to access the camera device. This allows the app to take pictures and record videos using the camera.

apis.name: RECORD_AUDIO
apis.description: Allows an application to record audio. This enables the app to capture sound through the device's microphone.

apis.name: READ_CONTACTS
apis.description: Allows an application to read the user's contacts data. This provides access to the list of accounts on the device, and contact names, phone numbers, email addresses, etc.

apis.name: WRITE_CONTACTS
apis.description: Allows an application to write the user's contacts data. This enables creating, modifying, or deleting contact information.

apis.name: READ_CALENDAR
apis.description: Allows an application to read the user's calendar data. This provides access to events, reminders, attendees, etc.

apis.name: WRITE_CALENDAR
apis.description: Allows an application to write the user's calendar data. This enables creating, modifying, or deleting calendar events.

apis.name: READ_CALL_LOG
apis.description: Allows an application to read the user's call log. This provides access to information about calls made and received.

apis.name: READ_PHONE_STATE
apis.description: Allows read only access to phone state, including the phone number of the device, current cellular network information, the status of any ongoing calls, and a list of any PhoneAccounts registered on the device.

apis.name: READ_PHONE_NUMBERS
apis.description: Allows read access to the device's phone number(s). This is a subset of the capabilities granted by READ_PHONE_STATE but on Android 8.0 (API level 26) and higher, it's a separate permission.

apis.name: READ_SMS
apis.description: Allows an application to read SMS messages. This enables the app to read all SMS messages stored on the device.

apis.name: READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
apis.description: Allows an application to read from external storage. This provides access to files stored by the user or other applications.

apis.name: WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
apis.description: Allows an application to write to external storage. This enables the app to create, modify, or delete files in shared storage.

apis.name: READ_MEDIA_IMAGES
apis.description: Allows an application to read image files from external storage. Introduced in Android 13 as a more granular replacement for READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.

apis.name: READ_MEDIA_VIDEO
apis.description: Allows an application to read video files from external storage. Introduced in Android 13 as a more granular replacement for READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.

apis.name: READ_MEDIA_AUDIO
apis.description: Allows an application to read audio files from external storage. Introduced in Android 13 as a more granular replacement for READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.

apis.name: ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION
apis.description: Allows an application to recognize physical activity. This permission allows the app to detect user activities such as walking, biking, driving, etc.

apis.name: BODY_SENSORS
apis.description: Allows an application to access data from sensors that monitor the user's physical condition, such as heart rate.
